page.content:
Coastal range east of Kennedy that hosted Mercury and Gemini launches.

How Cape Canaveral connects

  • Location: Kennedy Space Center — Kennedy Space Center sits on Merritt Island beside Cape Canaveral.
  • Faction: Project Mercury — Mercury crewed flights launched from Cape Canaveral pads.

What is Cape Canaveral?

Cape Canaveral Space Force Station adjoins Kennedy. NASA's earliest crewed flights left its pads before Apollo moved to the larger Complex 39.

Key threads lead to Kennedy Space Center and Project Mercury.
